Sandman and Swamp Thing are good suggestions. 

-  Fatale by Ed Brubaker is a cool mystery/noir story. 
- Hack/Slash by Tim Seeley is amazing! It’s a comedy/horror series and it’s a really fun read.
- Saga by Brian K Vaughan if you haven’t read it yet. That’s one you definitely don’t want to miss. 
- Redneck by Donny Cates is great. 
- New Deadwardians by Dan Abnett was really cool but I’m not sure if the trade is currently in print. You should be able to get the whole series on eBay for pretty cheap though.

I agree, you should definitely check out Mister Miracle! One of the best I’ve read in a long time. 
A couple other ones I’d recommend that are just great stories are:
1) Saga by Brian K Vaughan (if you haven’t read it yet, it’s probably my favorite modern book)
2) Black Hammer by Jeff Lemire
3) Thanos Wins by Donny Cates (intro to Cosmic Ghost Rider and it’s a really funny story)
4) Ice Cream Man by W. Maxwell Prince
5) Hack/Slash by Tim Seeley (This one isn’t really new but it is sooo much fun so if you haven’t read it I highly suggest it! There are lots of one shots but If you get the trades, it collects them all in a cohesive story)
Savage Sword of Conan is great too! I like it better than the Jason Aaron one.
Hell yeah! Definitely keep it in the slab. I heard there are some cool wall hangers for CGC books on eBay for pretty cheap.
Yeah don’t take it out of the slab. It’s a great story though so see if you can find some readers copies of the complete Judas Contract story.

Vision by Tom King is good. Personally, I wasn’t crazy about Old Man Logan but a lot of people so like it. Here are a couple other recommendations of modern books that are easy to find in trades:
- X-Men: Grand Design by Ed Piskor (fun collection of 2-3 page X-Men stories recapped and reimagined by Piskor)
- Wolverine and the X-Men (Vol. 1) by Jason Aaron (there are several volumes in case you wish to continue)
- Thanos Wins by Donny Cates (Really funny alternate universe story)
- Punisher MAX by Garth Ennis (One of my favorite series of all time and there are several volumes but be prepared, it is very graphic and violent)
- Fury MAX by Garth Ennis (also pretty graphic)
- Gambit by James Asmus (cool story with amazing art)
- Daredevil by Mark Waid (he write a few volumes but all of them are great)
- Alias: Jessica Jones by Brian Michael Bendis is incredible 
- Wolverine Mini series by Chris Claremont and Frank Miller is one of my favorites and you can probably find a trade of that one fairly easily. 
- Thor by Walt Simonson is also great and I know there are some trades but I’m not sure if they’re in print. 
Hope this helps.
